name: Royal Building of Mafra – Palace, Basilica, Convent, Cerco Garden and Hunting Park (Tapada)
description: Just 30 km northwest of Lisbon, Mafra is a vast quadrangular complex begun under King João V in the early 1700s. Inside are royal apartments, a Franciscan convent, and a basilica modelled on Roman Baroque churches. The library holds 36,000 volumes. Outside, a geometric garden and the walled Tapada hunting park stretch beyond the palace walls.
